description: Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply - Orders made to approve the acquisition of the immovable properties in Kandewatta, Galle Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District for the constructions under Galle Municipal Boundaries Wastewater Recycling Project and in Arukalmadam, Nallur D/S Division, Jaffna District for the constructions of Swerage Pump House No. 16 and in Oddumadam, Jaffna D/S Division, Jaffna District  for the constructions of Sewerage Pump House, NO. 25 under the Jaffna-Kilinochchi Water Supply & Sanitation Project
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains multiple orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of immovable property and servitude rights for specific land parcels described in detailed schedules. The content includes specific land descriptions, boundaries, locations, and claimant information, which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While a government minister is named, this is incidental to the core land acquisition purpose rather than being about government personnel or structural changes.
